setting: Setting: the Kingdom of Siam (Thailand) in the 19th century. It must look Thai: temples with steep multi-tiered orange-and-green roofs and golden chedi spires, the Chao Phraya river with wooden boats, Siamese nobles in silk jackets and wrapped chong kraben trousers, Buddhist monks in saffron robes, palm trees; Europeans wear 19th-century suits or naval uniforms. Respectful, dignified portrayal of everyone. No violence.

scenes.t1: Dusk on a wide river in Bangkok, 1893: two grey French steam gunboats with smoking funnels and French tricolor flags anchored in the middle of the river, their cannons pointed toward the golden spires and tiered roofs of the Grand Palace on the bank; small wooden boats rowing away, orange sky.
scenes.t2: A symbolic scene of colonial Southeast Asia: four stylised landmarks side by side on small hills, a golden Burmese pagoda, a Vietnamese citadel gate, a Cambodian stone temple with towers and a Javanese stone temple; a European flag is planted on each (British Union Jack, French tricolor, French tricolor, Dutch red-white-blue) with European soldiers standing guard.
scenes.t4: Inside a quiet Thai Buddhist temple: a thoughtful Siamese prince living as a monk in a saffron robe, with a shaved head, studying at a low desk with open European books, a brass telescope and a globe, while a friendly Western missionary in a black coat points at a page.
scenes.t5: 1868, a beach camp in Siam: the king of Siam in a dignified silk jacket standing beside a brass telescope, surrounded by European scientists in suits and Siamese nobles, all looking up at a total solar eclipse, a black sun with a glowing white corona in a darkened sky.
scenes.t6: 1855, a Siamese palace hall: the king of Siam in royal dress seated at a table signing a treaty with a British envoy in a dark diplomatic uniform, both dignified and calm; through the open doors a river harbour full of sailing merchant ships.
scenes.t7: A Siamese throne hall: a fifteen-year-old king in a white military-style uniform with a gold sash seated on a golden throne, gently raising his hand, while the courtiers who had been lying face-down on the floor are rising to stand up respectfully.
scenes.t8: Late 19th-century Siam modernising: a black steam locomotive pulling carriages on a new railway past Thai temples and palm trees, telegraph poles along the track, a small post office, and school children in uniforms waving.
scenes.t10: A 19th-century political cartoon in paper-cut style: a calm white elephant wearing a small golden Thai crown standing on a small piece of land in the centre, squeezed between a huge roaring lion wearing a British flag cape on the left and a big proud rooster wearing a French tricolor sash on the right.
scenes.t11: Night: the king of Siam in a white uniform sitting alone and sad on a palace balcony, head lowered, a cup of medicine on a small table beside him; below, the dark river with the silhouettes of two gunboats and their lights.
scenes.t12: A grove of tall green bamboo bending deeply in a strong wind without breaking, leaves flying, with a golden Thai temple spire and stormy clouds behind.
scenes.t14: A 19th-century political cartoon in paper-cut style: a lion wearing a British flag cape and a rooster wearing a French tricolor sash shaking hands across a low wooden fence, while between them, inside the fenced garden, a white elephant with a small golden Thai crown stands safe and calm.
scenes.t15: 1897, a European photographer's studio: the king of Siam in a white dress uniform with medals seated side by side as an equal with the Russian tsar in a dark uniform; a large wooden camera on a tripod with the photographer under a black cloth in the foreground.
scenes.t16: Present day Thailand: inside a small family shop-house, a framed portrait of a dignified king in a white uniform with a moustache hangs high on the wall, decorated with yellow marigold garlands; a grandmother and a child place flowers below it, warm light.
